evalCriteria.metric: No direct database access outside the service layer
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed file under conduit-next/app/** or conduit-next/components/** that imports from lib/db/models or calls a Sequelize model method directly scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: Client Components never import server-only modules
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed Client Component file containing an import from lib/services, lib/db, or lib/auth scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: Session validation happens only in middleware.ts
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed Route Handler or service file that reads the session cookie or calls a JWT-verify function directly (outside middleware.ts or lib/auth.js's own exported helper) scores 0.
evalCriteria.source: spec/plans/nfr.md (NFR Design — middleware.ts deny-by-default auth gate), spec/plans/application-design.md (Section 3)

evalCriteria.metric: No secrets, tokens, or PII in log output
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed log call (console.*, a logging helper) that passes a password field, a raw JWT/cookie value, or a full request/user object without redaction scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: No sequelize.sync({ alter: true }) in the ported code path
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed file under lib/db/** containing sync( with an alter option (or a bare sync() used as a migration mechanism) scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: Mass-assignment protection via explicit field allowlists
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed Route Handler under app/api/** that passes req.body (or an equivalent parsed-body object) directly into a service call or model create/update without an intervening allowlist/DTO scores 0.
evalCriteria.source: spec/plans/stories.md (Story 4 AC-4, Story 5 AC-4 — SECURITY-08 mass-assignment protection)
